description: This file defines the RtfFlattenVisitor class, a visitor for processing and flattening document objects related to RTF rendering in the MigraDoc library. It contains methods for visiting formatted text and hyperlinks to apply styles and Font cloning.

classes.name: RtfFlattenVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class for flattening document objects for RTF rendering, specifically handling formatted text and hyperlinks.

methods.name: VisitFormattedText
methods.description: Handles the flattening process for a formatted text object, applying styles and fonts based on the document's style definitions.

methods.name: VisitHyperlink
methods.description: Processes a hyperlink object to assign or clone its font based on the hyperlink style.
